title: AWS re:Invent 2017: How Netflix Tunes Amazon EC2 Instances for Performance (CMP325)
summary: A Netflix performance engineer presents how Netflix tunes EC2 instances, covering instance type choice, Xen modes, SR-IOV and kernel tuning. The goal is near bare-metal performance in the cloud.
why: HN cites it as an example of workload-dependent performance tuning at scale and of Netflix's AWS practices.

quote.text: performance tuning is an art form as it is workload dependant
